requirements.summary: Never invent College Football 27 options, labels, menu paths, presets, sliders, hairstyles, facial-hair options, or platform differences.
requirements.evidence: Production catalog is empty; catalog validation, placeholder checks, fixture checks, duplicate checks, and production bundle guard pass.

requirements.summary: Classify binding, advisory, superseded, and unrelated source documents before changing catalog, matching, capture, privacy, or verification behavior.
requirements.evidence: Integrity checks assert the source registry exists, includes GameFace Match binding sources, and excludes the unrelated Skaggs Systems source.

requirements.summary: Use the responsive web application as the active MVP while preserving native iOS for future premium TrueDepth capture.
requirements.evidence: Web E2E tests pass and iOS build/UI tests pass; documentation identifies web as active MVP and iOS as preserved future path.

requirements.summary: Document current architectural decisions and known gaps without risky rewrites.
requirements.evidence: ADRs cover web MVP, iOS preservation, local facial processing, adapter boundaries, catalog separation, evidence paths, immutable releases, raw media, recommendation gates, catalog manager boundaries, second review, and patch handling.

requirements.summary: Guide the user through standardized multi-angle face capture and allow retake of failed sections.
requirements.evidence: Five required RGB angles, upload fallback, retake, removal, review, and cancellation flows are implemented and tested.
requirements.blocker: Real mobile camera behavior still requires physical-device QA.

requirements.summary: Validate iPhone Safari and Android Chrome camera behavior, interruption recovery, permission reset, and mobile viewport behavior on real devices.
requirements.evidence: Automated viewport and fallback checks pass; real-device HTTPS testing remains documented but incomplete.
requirements.blocker: Requires physical iPhone/Android devices and HTTPS test origin.

requirements.summary: Use local browser face landmark processing behind a provider interface without uploads, identity recognition, or fabricated landmarks.
requirements.evidence: Provider interface, MediaPipe runtime integration, worker boundary, unavailable/error states, and tests exist.
requirements.blocker: Reviewed local MediaPipe model asset is not present at web/public/models/mediapipe/face_landmarker.task.

requirements.summary: Generate a standardized face profile that separates geometry and appearance without raw frame persistence.
requirements.evidence: Profile serialization, unavailable measurement states, depthSupported false, source angle availability, and synthetic geometry tests pass.
requirements.blocker: Real landmark model and real-device repeatability are not verified.

requirements.summary: Keep production College Football 27 catalog data separate from fixtures and reject unverified records.
requirements.evidence: Empty production catalog validates; unverified, fixture, placeholder, missing metadata, malformed measurement, duplicate ID, and unavailable asset cases are tested.

requirements.source: EA Sports College Football 27 - Complete Appearance Catalog Research and Verification Prompt
requirements.summary: Do not publish College Football 27 options without shipping-game evidence and required review.
requirements.evidence: Audit templates, CSV import/export, review validation, package validation, publication and rollback tooling exist.
requirements.blocker: No owner-supplied shipping-game evidence package is present; production catalog has zero verified records.

requirements.section: D-007 - Empty production catalog fails closed
requirements.summary: Empty production catalog is valid but must not produce recommendations.
requirements.evidence: Adapter and results tests confirm catalog-unavailable behavior; E2E path reaches honest catalog-unavailable results.

requirements.summary: Centralize feature and capability gates so production recommendations require an approved catalog release and cannot be enabled by environment flags alone.
requirements.evidence: Unit tests prove fixtures, unverified catalogs, and version mismatches block recommendations; approved releases enable recommendations only through the checksum-verified catalog path.

requirements.source: GameFace Match Phase Zero Readiness Review
requirements.summary: Calculate Phase 0 readiness from actual repository and catalog state without inflated percentages.
requirements.evidence: The status service reports all required Phase 0 areas and keeps shipping-game, catalog, second-review, and manual matching work blocked while the production catalog is empty.

requirements.source: GameFace Match Phase Zero Readiness Review
requirements.summary: Define the complete Phase 0 audit domain model with stable identifiers, enums, timestamps, and version fields without populating real game option records.
requirements.evidence: The Phase 0 domain model covers game, platform, version, patch, audit environment, creation paths, menu items, capture configuration, catalog candidate item kinds, evidence, capture events, issues, recapture, verification, discrepancies, releases, imports, manual matching studies, and subject results. Tests use synthetic-only data and verify publication gates.

requirements.source: EA Sports College Football 27 - Complete Appearance Catalog Research and Verification Prompt
requirements.summary: Validate and persist audit environments and creation paths with source-required console, game, capture, player-context, evidence, reproducible-step, dependency, and verification metadata.
requirements.evidence: Audit environment and creation-path schemas require platform, console, game update, online/account, display/capture, player-context, entitlement, evidence, reproducible-step, requirement, restriction, appearance-relevance, dependency, and verification fields. The audit store validates before saving and migrates unversioned local snapshots.

requirements.summary: Implement explainable weighted-distance matching with confidence-aware weighting, missing-feature handling, tie behavior, and traceability.
requirements.evidence: Synthetic tests cover ordering, missing features, low confidence, redistribution, ties, explanations, deterministic output, catalog version, and empty-catalog fail-closed behavior.
requirements.blocker: Real production matching cannot be verified until verified catalog records exist.

requirements.summary: Keep skin tone and user appearance selections separate from geometric similarity and avoid identity probability language.
requirements.evidence: Tests cover geometry separated from skin presentation and score language says match score is based on available game options, not identity probability.

requirements.summary: Return top three in-game recommendations and explain how to reproduce settings manually.
requirements.evidence: Results states and build instruction format exist, but no production records or verified menu instructions are loaded.
requirements.blocker: Verified College Football 27 production catalog and menu evidence are required.

requirements.summary: Allow screenshot upload for future created-player refinement without pretending comparison logic exists.
requirements.evidence: Screenshot intake, validation, deletion, and unavailable result are implemented and tested.
requirements.blocker: Real cross-domain comparison and verified catalog data are not available.

requirements.summary: Do not upload face images and do not persist raw face images in localStorage.
requirements.evidence: Privacy tests cover local-only behavior, raw images absent from localStorage, no network upload behavior, inventory accuracy, and deletion flows.

requirements.summary: Use separate consent acknowledgments for camera use, face analysis, temporary processing, saving derived profiles, saving builds, screenshots, and future participation.
requirements.evidence: Tests cover consent versioning, separate consent controls, missing required consent rejection, and disabled future participation controls.

requirements.summary: Support deletion of active capture session, temporary images, derived profiles, saved builds, screenshots, all local data, and deletion records.
requirements.evidence: Unit and E2E tests cover session cleanup, object URL cleanup, profile deletion, saved build deletion, screenshot deletion, delete-all behavior, and deletion confirmation.

requirements.summary: Configure web security headers, avoid production source maps, exclude dev-only routes from production navigation, and prevent fixture leakage.
requirements.evidence: Security header, source-map, fixture exclusion, development navigation exclusion, integrity, and production bundle guard tests pass.

requirements.summary: Maintain automated coverage for catalog validation, capture, privacy, matching, refinement, fixture exclusion, navigation, and production gates.
requirements.evidence: `npm run verify` passed end-to-end with web tests, Playwright tests, catalog checks, production build, and iOS build/unit/UI tests.

requirements.summary: Provide safe Git/worktree hygiene checks for staged, modified, untracked, ignored, oversized, fixture, secret, and media-risk files.
requirements.evidence: `node scripts/repository-status.mjs --strict` reports current Git state and exits successfully with zero warnings.

requirements.summary: Do not label the product ready for private beta until capture completion, quality pass, repeatability, acceptance, crash-free, deletion, processing time, and catalog-error gates are met.
requirements.evidence: Beta gates are documented and automated dry-run coverage exists, but real tester metrics have not been collected.
requirements.blocker: Requires verified catalog, local model asset, HTTPS device testing, and real tester sessions.

requirements.summary: Do not deploy or connect external services until owner supplies hosting, domain, legal, support, and payment-provider decisions.
requirements.evidence: Environment validation and provider-independent payment scaffolds exist; no deployment or payment provider is connected.
requirements.blocker: Owner decisions and verified product value are required before deployment/payments.

requirements.summary: Preserve the native iOS foundation without expanding it during web MVP work.
requirements.evidence: Native iOS build, unit tests, and UI tests pass under the unified verification command.
